title: Cars Toy Chests Sold at Toys "R" Us Recalled by Delta Enterprise Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The red paint on the partition panels of the toy box contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 3,000.

title: Enesco Group Inc. Recalls Heartwood Creek® Turtle Sprinklers for Laceration Hazard
summary: When connected to a garden hose, under normal household water pressure, the sprinkler can break or shatter, presenting a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,600.

title: Gund Inc. Recalls Woodles™ Activity Toys for Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden rings on the stuffed toy can break, posing a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: About 18,900.

title: Remote Control Helix Micro Helicopter Toys Recalled for Burn Hazard
summary: The controller power supply can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 46,200.

title: DeWalt Recalls Framing Saws and Circular Saws for Laceration Hazard
summary: The lower blade guard can fail to close, leaving the blade exposed and presenting a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 97,000 framing saws and 37,000 circular saws.

title: Warn Industries Inc. Recalls Eight-Post ATV Winch Kits for Overheating
summary: A component of the winch kit, the eight-post contactor, can continue to pull current when in the "off" position, which can cause it to overheat and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 218,000.

title: WMH Tool Group Inc. Recalls Wilton Mitre Saws for Laceration Hazard
summary: The aluminum cast pivot joint that connects the base of the saw to the head assembly (which contains the saw blade) can crack under extreme pressure or force, causing the blade assembly to unexpectedly break free from the stationary base. title: RC2 Recalls Toy Keys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The colored top portion of the keys can crack, resulting in the release of small parts, which poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 275,000.

title: Various Firms Recall Flashing Pacifiers for Choking, Aspiration and Strangulation Hazards
summary: These pacifiers failed to meet federal safety standards for pacifiers. The nipple can separate from the shield easily, posing a choking hazard. title: Atico International USA, Inc. Recalls Espresso Makers for Burn and Impact Injury Hazards
summary: The espresso maker's heating element can forcefully separate from its base during the brewing cycle. This poses burn and impact injury hazards to nearby consumers. Units: About 54,000.

title: Pottery Barn Recalls Gourd Candles for Fire Hazard
summary: The gourd candles can have excessive flame height and could fail to self-extinguish when burning down to the bottom of the candle, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 68,000.

title: Serious Injuries Prompt Recall of Mattel's Polly Pocket Magnetic Play Sets
summary: Tiny magnets inside the dolls and accessories can fall out undetected by parents and caregivers. The magnets can be swallowed, aspirated by young children or placed by a child in their nose or ears. title: Desk Lamps Sold at Office Depot Recalled for Shock Hazard
summary: The fiberglass sheath intended to protect the electrical cord can become improperly aligned during consumer assembly of the lamp. This poses a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,800.

title: Scott Electric Co. Inc. Recalls Counterfeit Circuit Breakers Due To Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled circuit breakers labeled "Square D" are counterfeit and might not trip when they are overloaded, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: Decorative Snaps and Metal Clips Recalled by Provo Craft Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled clips and snaps contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 76,000.

title: Target Recalls "Play Wonder" Puzzle Tables for Choking and Laceration Hazards
summary: The handles on the puzzle pieces can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Also, the tips of the nails on the inside shelf of the puzzle table could be exposed, posing a laceration or puncture hazard. Units: About 7,100.

title: Target Recalls Various Toys Due to Lead and Laceration Hazards
summary: Some of these toys contain lead paint, which is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Also, some of the toys have sharp points, posing laceration or puncture wound hazards. Units: About 190,500.

title: ANSUL Recalls Fire Extinguisher that Could Fail to Operate
summary: If the fire extinguisher is dropped horizontally from a height of approximately 2 to 3 feet, the pick-up tube could crack at the threads between the pick-up tube adaptor and the stainless steel tube. title: Dollar Days International Recalls Children's Parka Jackets with Drawstrings for Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: 180.

title: HSN LP Recalls Ultrex-Brand Pressure Cookers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The pressure cooker's lid can open while its contents are under pressure, allowing the hot contents to be expelled and causing burn injuries to bystanders. Units: About 1,450.

title: Trane Recalls Air Conditioners after Incidents of Units Smoking
summary: The heating element on these commercially installed units can become displaced and, if it contacts metal, could short circuit. title: MTD Southwest Inc. Recalls Troy-Bilt, Craftsman Chain Saws, Breaking Handles Pose Laceration Hazard
summary: The chain saw's plastic front handle can break during operation. If this occurs, the saw would be difficult to control and poses a risk for lacerations. Units: About 76.000.
